verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Finix serves an llms.txt at docs.finix.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a structured Finix Docs index). Its docs pages are published as raw .md URLs that agents can ingest directly. It also documents an MCP server, with a Claude Code setup guide, so agents can query the API documentation and get current answers. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using llms.txt or the docs MCP, and evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content variant.
